info.title: ZIA Cloud Service and Sandbox Submission APIs
info.description: API Reference Guide for the ZIA Cloud Service and Sandbox Submission APIs

get.description: Retrieves information about the advanced settings configured in the ZIA Admin Portal

put.description: Updates the advanced settings configuration in the ZIA Admin Portal. To learn more, see Configuring Advanced Settings.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Advanced settings in the ZIA Admin Portal

AdvancedSettings.description: Advanced settings available for configuration in the ZIA Admin Portal. To learn more, see Configuring Advanced Settings.

authBypassUrlCategories.description: URL categories that are exempted from cookie authentication

domainFrontingBypassUrlCategories.description: URL categories that are exempted from domain fronting

authBypassUrls.description: Custom URLs that are exempted from cookie authentication for users

authBypassApps.description: Cloud applications that are exempted from cookie authenticatio

kerberosBypassUrlCategories.description: URL categories that are exempted from Kerberos authentication

kerberosBypassUrls.description: Custom URLs that are exempted from Kerberos authentication

kerberosBypassApps.description: Cloud applications that are exempted from Kerberos authentication

basicBypassUrlCategories.description: URL categories that are exempted from Basic authentication

basicBypassApps.description: Cloud applications that are exempted from Basic authentication

httpRangeHeaderRemoveUrlCategories.description: URL categories for which HTTP range headers must be removed

digestAuthBypassUrlCategories.description: URL categories that are exempted from Digest authentication

digestAuthBypassUrls.description: Custom URLs that are exempted from Digest authentication

digestAuthBypassApps.description: Cloud applications that are exempted from Digest authentication

enableDnsResolutionOnTransparentProxy.description: A Boolean value indicating whether DNS optimization is enabled or disabled for Z-Tunnel 2.0 and transparent proxy mode traffic (e.g., traffic via GRE or IPSec tunnels without a PAC file). This setting allows Zscaler to perform a DNS lookup and override the externally resolved IP addresses in the outbound HTTP and HTTPS connections to establish a connection to the destination server that is geographically closer to the ZIA Service Edge (Public, Private, or Virtual).

enableIPv6DnsResolutionOnTransparentProx.description: A Boolean value indicating whether DNS optimization is enabled or disabled for IPv6 traffic sent via Z-Tunnel 2.0 and transparent proxy mode traffic (e.g., traffic via GRE or IPSec tunnels without a PAC file).

enableIPv6DnsOptimizationOnAllTransparen.description: A Boolean value indicating whether DNS optimization is enabled or disabled for all IPv6 transparent proxy traffic

enableEvaluatePolicyOnGlobalSSLBypass.description: A Boolean value indicating whether policy evaluation for global SSL bypass traffic is enabled or not

dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyExemptUrl.description: URL categories that are excluded from DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode

dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyIPv6Exemp.description: IPv6 URL categories that are excluded from DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode

dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyExemptUrl.description: URLs that are excluded from DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode

dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyExemptApp.description: Cloud applications that are excluded from DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode

dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyIPv6Exemp.description: Cloud applications that are excluded from DNS optimization for IPv6 addresses on transparent proxy mode

dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyUrlCatego.description: URL categories to which DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode applies

dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyIPv6UrlCa.description: IPv6 URL categories to which DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode applies

dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyUrls.description: URLs to which DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode applies

dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyApps.description: Cloud applications to which DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode applies

dnsResolutionOnTransparentProxyIPv6Apps.description: Cloud applications to which DNS optimization for IPv6 addresses on transparent proxy mode applies

blockDomainFrontingApps.description: Applications that are exempted from domain fronting

preferSniOverConnHostApps.description: Applications that are exempted from the preferSniOverConnHost setting

enableOffice365.description: A Boolean value indicating whether Microsoft Office 365 One Click Configuration is enabled or not

logInternalIp.description: A Boolean value indicating whether to log internal IP address present in X-Forwarded-For (XFF) proxy header or not

enforceSurrogateIpForWindowsApp.description: Enforce Surrogate IP authentication for Windows app traffic

trackHttpTunnelOnHttpPorts.description: A Boolean value indicating whether to apply configured policies on tunneled HTTP traffic sent via a CONNECT method request on port 80

blockHttpTunnelOnNonHttpPorts.description: A Boolean value indicating whether HTTP CONNECT method requests to non-standard ports are allowed or not (i.e., requests directed to ports other than the standard HTTP and HTTPS ports, 80 and 443)

blockDomainFrontingOnHostHeader.description:
A Boolean value indicating whether to block HTTP and HTTPS transactions that have an FQDN mismatch between:

  • The request URL and the request's host header. The service doesn't consider it a mismatch if either of the fields, host header, or FQDN URL is empty.
  • The SNI and the inner request's host header. The service doesn't consider it a mismatch if either of the fields, host header, or SNI is empty.

zscalerClientConnector1AndPacRoadWarrior.description: A Boolean value indicating whether to apply the Firewall rules configured without a specified location criteria (or with the Road Warrior location) to remote user traffic forwarded via Z-Tunnel 1.0 or PAC files

cascadeUrlFiltering.description: A Boolean value indicating whether to apply the URL Filtering policy even when the Cloud App Control policy already allows a transaction explicitly

enablePolicyForUnauthenticatedTraffic.description: A Boolean value indicating whether policies that include user and department criteria can be configured and applied for unauthenticated traffic

blockNonCompliantHttpRequestOnHttpPorts.description: A Boolean value indicating whether to allow or block traffic that is not compliant with RFC HTTP protocol standards

enableAdminRankAccess.description: A Boolean value indicating whether ranks are enabled for admins to allow admin ranks in policy configuration and management

uiSessionTimeout.description: Specifies the login session timeout for admins accessing the ZIA Admin Portal

apiSessionTimeout.description: Specifies the idle timeout duration for public API-initiated sessions. You can configure this field to any value ranging from 5 minutes to 20 minutes. The default value is 5 minutes.

http2NonbrowserTrafficEnabled.description: A Boolean value indicating whether or not HTTP/2 should be the default web protocol for accessing various applications at your organizational level

ecsForAllEnabled.description: A Boolean value indicating whether or not to include the ECS option in all DNS queries, originating from all locations and remote users.

ecsObject.description: The ECS prefix that must be used in DNS queries when the ECS option is enabled

dynamicUserRiskEnabled.description: A Boolean value indicating whether to dynamically update user risk score by tracking risky user activities in real time

blockConnectHostSniMismatch.description: A Boolean value indicating whether CONNECT host and SNI mismatch (i.e., CONNECT host doesn't match the SSL/TLS client hello SNI) is blocked or not

preferSniOverConnHost.description: A Boolean value indicating whether or not to use the SSL/TLS client hello Server Name Indication (SNI) for DNS resolution instead of the CONNECT host for forward proxy connections

sipaXffHeaderEnabled.description: A Boolean value indicating whether or not to insert XFF header to all traffic forwarded from ZIA to ZPA, including source IP-anchored and ZIA-inspected ZPA application traffic.

blockNonHttpOnHttpPortEnabled.description: A Boolean value indicating whether non-HTTP Traffic on HTTP and HTTPS ports are allowed or blocked

sniDnsOptimizationBypassUrlCategories.description: URL categories that are excluded from the preferSniOverConnHost setting (i.e., prefer SSL/TLS client hello SNI for DNS resolution instead of the CONNECT host for forward proxy connections)

urlSupercategory.description: Super category of the URL category. This field is required when creating custom URL categories.

name.description: The name of the URL category listed under the respective super category

comments.description: Additional information about the URL category

webApplicationClass.description: The cloud application class selected from the available options

id.description: A unique identifier for an entity

name.description: The configured name of the entity

externalId.description: An external identifier used for an entity that is managed outside of ZIA. Examples include zpaServerGroup and zpaAppSegments. This field is not applicable to ZIA-managed entities.

EntityReference.description: This is an immutable reference to an entity that mainly consists of an ID and name
